scope: Proposition 6.2 of the manuscript “Sharp mass bounds for the two-dimensional O(4) model” (preprints/Sharp-mass-bounds-for-the-two-dimensional-O4-model-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e87f407df77777ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every admitted nearest-neighbor trajectory of length N, starting with zero canonical interactions, whose terminal coupling belongs to a fixed compact interval IH about a sufficiently large H, its initial coupling β satisfies N log L = πβ − 1 2 log β + OL,H(1). (6.22) In particular L−N is bounded above and below by positive fixed multiples of √ βe−πβ.
